name: Great Wall Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Great Wall Enterprise Co., Ltd. engages in agricultural and animal products business in Taiwan, China, Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Cambodia. The company is involved in edible oil and fat manufacturing and wholesale; food dealership; grain husking; manufacturing of grain mill products, starches, and starch products; noodles and vermicelli food manufacturing; feed and fertilizer manufacturing; and wholesale of food, groceries, animal feed, veterinary drugs, plastic films and bags, and fertilizer, as well as livestock and poultry.
